cross_market_insights: No page in the AU top 10 answers the query as asked: results are northern-winter venue lists, honeymoon-in-February lists and Instagram. Intent mismatch is the gap.
Google reads 'February' as winter even for Australian searchers; nobody frames February as a two-hemisphere month (tropical dry season, Gulf cool season, Alpine snow, southern summer).
PAA asks 'Is February a good time for a wedding?' and 'Which country is best to visit in February?': an opening answer block plus FAQ can win both.
Nobody covers Valentine's Day demand, Ramadan timing or which destinations to avoid in February (Bali, Fiji wet and cyclone season).
Wedded Wonderland already ranks top 10 in Sydney and Melbourne with off-topic winter pages, so domain relevance exists.
payload.recommended_angle: A two-hemisphere February ranking for Australian couples: dry-season islands, Gulf cool season, Alpine snow and Australian summer, each with an honest caveat, a 'where to wait' box and the Valentine's week booking reality.
